tips.1: Take your photo in good light
tips.2: Look straight ahead and keep your head level
tips.3: Avoid sunglasses, hats and heavy shadows
tips.4: Use a plain background for cleaner replacement

1.q: Can I submit this photo with an application?
1.a: You can create a photo in the requested size. Check the recipient’s size, background and face requirements before submitting it.

2.a: Yes. Choose a preset or custom color. The tool separates the subject before replacing the background to preserve clothing. Use Remove background if you need to refine individual edges.

3.q: How can I get a sharper photo?
3.a: Use a clear, well-lit original and avoid cropping too tightly. Check the actual resolution shown beside the preview before printing.

4.q: Can I print the photos at home?
4.a: Yes. Choose paper size and copies under Advanced, then select Print photos. Print at actual size / 100%, with fit-to-page disabled.

1.q: Does this change my original file?
1.a: No. Save edited photo creates a new image file. The original file on your device stays unchanged.

2.a: The download uses the selected area at the original image resolution. Its exact dimensions appear under Output area.

3.q: Can I enter exact crop dimensions?
3.a: Yes. Open Advanced and enter coordinates and dimensions in pixels. With a fixed aspect ratio, the other dimension adjusts to keep that ratio.

4.q: Can I make an ID photo afterwards?
4.a: Yes. After saving, select Make an ID photo from this image to open the result in the ID photo tool.

1.q: How many photos can I combine?
1.a: Quick collage supports 2 to 9 JPG, PNG or WebP photos. Add, remove and reorder them before exporting.

2.q: Why are the edges of my photos cropped?
2.a: Quick collage center-crops photos into square tiles. Check the preview or use advanced layouts to choose how photos fit.

3.q: What dimensions will my download have?
3.a: Each tile is 900 × 900 px. Total dimensions depend on rows, columns and spacing. Exact dimensions appear below the preview.

4.q: Can I add text or a logo?
4.a: Yes. Open Advanced layouts to choose a template and add a title or logo. Your selected photos carry over to that mode.

tips.3: Originals are retained if outputs are not smaller

1.a: JPG and WebP are re-encoded at the selected quality level. PNG uses its own compression and does not apply JPG quality settings.

2.a: Already optimized images may not shrink. The tool keeps originals when re-encoded files are not smaller.

3.a: Dimensions are preserved by default. You can limit the long edge; a result replaces the original only if its file is smaller.
